correctness.rationale: For F3 every nonzero coordinate has square one; for any subset S of three basis positions the idempotent equation forces x_j=sum_{i∈S}w_ij. Checking exactly the support constraint bijects nonempty supports with nonzero idempotents. Exhaustive finite domain contains 3^9=19683 matrices and 11232 invertible. Independently evaluated all 27 candidate vectors on each invertible W and independently BFS-tested strong connectivity: labeled histogram 3600,5056,1800,600,120,48,0,8 (k=0..7) and simple 3408,3256,768,72; independently partitioned invertible matrices into all orbits under the exact 48-element S3×(F3*)^3 action, yielding class spectra 78,111,40,15,3,1,0,1 and simple 74,73,17,2. The source census.py separately checks stabilizers and direct orbits, and 249 is attributed to known work. Finite enumeration is complete for the specified field/dimension; not an extrapolation.
residual_risks: Orbit action is valid for perfect evolution algebras because all natural bases are monomial; this does not classify nonperfect algebras.
